notes: 25 candidates reviewed from saved Common Crawl text (2023 captures): 2 program-list, 0 single-record, 23 not-a-list. Program lists: (1) UF Warrington PhD in Management alumni page, 2001-2022, ~44 graduates with initial placement and current job; it is the management/OB program, so the area will need classification and most people fall outside operations. (2) UH Bauer college-wide 'Recent Placements' table, 2017-2023, with a Field column (SCM and MIS entries are the ones relevant to operations/decision sciences; the bauer.uh.edu/doctoral/mis/placement.php and /scm/placement.php stubs only point to this page). The Terry (UGA) Management PhD job-candidates page probably carries candidate cards on the live site, but the capture holds no names, so it was marked not-a-list rather than guessed. The Helsinki candidate is a HELDA RIS-export URL for a 2012 Hanken School of Economics dissertation (Markus Wartiovaara, 'Values and Freedom', Management and Organisation); the saved page body is empty and Hanken is not an institution in the current data, so it was kept under the given host institution (University of Helsinki) as not-a-list; an integrator who adds Hanken could treat the handle record (hdl.handle.net/10138/34157) as a single dissertation record. The UConn alumni site pages are undergraduate/MBA alumni relations content (Hall of Fame, news notes, mentors); the Hall of Fame list names two people with UConn PhDs (Gayle A. Russell '95 PhD, Gwo-Duan D. Jou '92 PhD) but is not a program graduate list. The Bauer 'Alumni Voices' page names roughly fifteen PhD alumni with current positions and a few graduation years (e.g. Ranasinghe, Accounting 2012; Chen, Accounting 2009; Kalimipalli, Finance 1995-99; Griffin 1978); it is a testimonial page and mostly non-operations fields, so it was left as not-a-list.
